backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing a social media marketing service platform with user profiles, services (followers/likes/views for Facebook/Instagram/YouTube/TikTok), cart/order management, testimonials, and role-based access control (admin/user permissions).
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four completed branding updates: changing site name from 'SMM Ourprice' to 'IBAZEX', updating WhatsApp number to +212615473531, and updating Instagram and Facebook social media links.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components describing an Arabic RTL e-commerce platform for social media services with cart, checkout, admin dashboard, service management, and testimonials functionality using React, TanStack Router, and shadcn/ui.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining light and dark theme color schemes using oklch color space for background, foreground, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, border, and sidebar colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point configured for Arabic RTL layout with 'SMM Ourprice' title (not yet updated to IBAZEX), favicon, Inter font preload, and root div for React mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React application component setting up TanStack Router with three routes (home/Hero, services, admin) wrapped in ThemeProvider and CartProvider with shared Header/Footer layout.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminDashb: Admin dashboard with tabbed interface for overview, services, orders, and testimonials management sections.
frontend/src/components/admin/DashboardO: Dashboard overview displaying key metrics (total orders, pending orders, total revenue in Dh) and recent order activity list with loading skeletons.
frontend/src/components/admin/OrdersTabl: Admin component displaying all customer orders in a table with status badges (pending/completed/cancelled) and a dropdown to update order status. Uses React Query hooks for fetching orders and updating status with toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/admin/ServiceMan: Admin component for managing social media services with a table view and dialog form to add new services. Allows toggling service availability and handles platform/service type selection with price configuration in Dirhams.
frontend/src/components/admin/Testimonia: Admin component for managing customer testimonials with a table display and dialog form to add new testimonials. Includes service type selection, star ratings (1-5), and customer name/text input with validation.
frontend/src/components/Cart.tsx: Empty file (content truncated or not provided).
frontend/src/components/CheckoutPage.tsx: Empty file (content truncated or not provided).
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Arabic footer component displaying IBAZEX branding, quick navigation links, social media icons (Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp) with updated links, contact information with WhatsApp number +212615473531, and copyright notice with Caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header navigation component with IBAZEX logo and brand name in cyan, featuring Arabic navigation links for home, services, and admin dashboard with active state styling.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Hero section component displaying the IBAZEX brand, tagline in Arabic, WhatsApp contact info, and feature cards for followers, likes, and views with animated entrance effects.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCard.tsx: Card component for displaying a social media service with platform/service icons, quantity input (100-1M range), dynamic price calculation per 1000 units, and WhatsApp contact button.
frontend/src/components/ServicesPage.tsx: Services listing page with platform filter tabs (all, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok) that displays available services in a responsive grid using ServiceCard components.
frontend/src/components/Testimonials.tsx: Testimonials section component that fetches and displays customer reviews with ratings, service type badges, and customer names in a responsive card grid.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state. Initializes access control with admin token from URL params and invalidates dependent queries when actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCart.tsx: React Context provider and hook for managing shopping cart state including add/remove/update items, quantity tracking, and total price calculation. Calculates prices per 1000 units based on service baseUnitPriceDh.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication using @dfinity/auth-client. Manages login state, identity persistence, and provides login/logout functions with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and mutating services, orders, and testimonials data via the backend actor, with automatic cache invalidation on mutations.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for theming (light/dark modes), RTL direction for Arabic text, and custom animation keyframes for fade-in, slide-in, and zoom effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from query strings or hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence and cleanup capabilities.
frontend/src/utils/whatsapp.ts: Generates WhatsApp URLs with pre-filled Arabic messages for service orders, including platform, service type, quantity, and price details.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes, typography, animations, and plugins for the IBAZEX SMM services platform.
project_state.json: Project metadata documenting the IBAZEX SMM platform architecture, features, branding (Arabic UI, WhatsApp integration), and social media contact information.
